summary.zh: 开关的圆钮是个会睡觉的小团子。打开时被叫醒：吓一跳、蓄力，弹到另一头变成太阳，天也跟着亮；关上时打个哈欠，慢吞吞挪回去继续睡，头上冒 Zzz。
summary.en: The toggle knob is a sleepy little blob. Switch it on and it startles awake, winds up and springs across to become the sun as the sky brightens; switch it off and it yawns, shuffles back slowly and dozes off with a trail of Zzz.

technique.zh: 全部是 WAAPI。位移走弹簧：把阻尼振动采样成 CSS linear() 缓动；身体的挤压拉伸（蓄力压扁 → 空中拉长 → 落地回弹）手写关键帧。白天用 clip-path 圆从圆钮位置扩散出来，关灯时再缩回去。表情是三组 SVG 眼睛切换显隐。
technique.en: All WAAPI. Travel uses a spring: a damped oscillation sampled into a CSS linear() easing; the squash & stretch (wind-up squash → mid-air stretch → landing rebound) is hand-keyed. Daylight is a clip-path circle that grows out of the knob and shrinks back at night. Expressions swap between three SVG eye sets.

desc.zh: 醒来那一下的总时长（蓄力 + 弹过去）
犯困挪回去的时长，故意慢
弹簧回弹程度（0 不弹 ~ .8 很弹）

adapt.zh: 任何开关都能换上：深色模式、通知、静音。换角色只要换 .face 里的 SVG。
adapt.en: Works for any switch: dark mode, notifications, mute. Swap the SVG inside .face for your own character.
